scripts.//test: Pure modpack parity logic. The rest of main.ts depends on Electron and is not testable without it.
scripts.test: node --test electron/parity.test.mjs electron/disk.test.mjs electron/version-gate.test.mjs electron/ui-integrity.test.mjs electron/voice-helper-sync.test.mjs electron/voice-handoff.test.mjs electron/packaging.test.mjs electron/connection-settings.test.mjs electron/game-process.test.mjs electron/launch-contract.test.mjs electron/server-mods.test.mjs electron/nexus-mods.test.mjs electron/launcher-update.test.mjs electron/skse-install.test.mjs electron/skyrim-downgrade.test.mjs
scripts.//build: `tsc -b` and not `tsc`: the root tsconfig.json is a solution file with `files: []`, so `tsc` alone checked no project at all — the build passed with type errors in src/ and electron/.
scripts.//build2: stage-voice-helper runs first: it copies voice-helper.exe (C++/CMake build) to build-resources/ for electron-builder to package as resources/vendor/, or warns and carries on without it (voice is optional).
scripts.build: node scripts/stage-voice-helper.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && electron-builder
